name: Meikyu
storyline: Five residents make up today’s hidden dungeon lineup. You get six tries to name them and put each one in the right slot. Every sortie leaves a report: who is right, who belongs elsewhere, and who is not on the floor. Across days, you also uncover the residents’ unwritten house rules.
summary: Meikyu is a free daily deduction game played in the browser. Each day, the dungeon hides a five-resident lineup drawn from a cast of thirty-six. You have six sorties to identify the cast and place everyone in the right slot.
